listing.name: Uncharted2: Among Thieves — PS4 remaster (bc160201983 Uncharted PC port)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared Windows Nathan Drake Collection installation starting Uncharted: Among Thieves. The BilalReloaded launcher keeps title-specific settings; upstream owns preparation, runtime replacement and external player data.

steps.title: Prepare this PS4 collection upstream first
steps.instruction: Use a complete copy and components you are independently permitted to use. This record targets Uncharted: Among Thieves within your own decrypted PS4 Nathan Drake Collection CUSA02344 folder, containing eboot.bin and sce_sys (often the uroot folder). The reviewed0.8.0 instructions recommend your own matching1.02 update; without it most port crash fixes are skipped. Follow upstream setup outside Portcove, choose the collection folder/update and save this game’s settings. PS3 original releases are different inputs. No exact full-game digest or other regional edition is qualified here.

steps.title: Keep the complete matching package
steps.instruction: Keep Uncharted Launcher.exe with the complete python, launcher, tools, gow3_pc and other package directories from the same prepared Uncharted-windows package. The native starter invokes its bundled python/pythonw.exe and launcher script; it is not a standalone game. Do not select Python, the internal runtime probe, a DLL or an original PS4 game executable for this attachment. This guide obtains or executes no setup tool, original or game.

steps.title: Select the Among Thieves play intent
steps.instruction: Select Uncharted Launcher.exe, use its complete extracted package directory as working directory, and set the two arguments --play u2. Review the exact selected intent, then request Play separately. The pinned launcher maps u2 specifically to big2-ps4_Shipping.elf; the native starter waits for the launcher, and direct play keeps it until its game/probe job completes. Finish any missing setup outside the attached attempt. Collection switching is an upstream feature, not independent qualification of the other titles.

steps.title: Preserve collection and per-game data
steps.instruction: Keep the whole package analysis directory, particularly analysis/uncharted-user with savedata, trophy, caches, probe.ini and probe-u2.ini, plus %APPDATA%/Uncharted Launcher/launcher.json. The selected source supports per-game save profiles and separate instance roots; retain every already established custom/instance root and original base/update folder. Do not assume that changing copies, region, profile or runtime migrates or preserves compatible saves automatically. No import, save migration, backup or external-file deletion is performed here.

steps.title: Complete updates and shutdown outside attachment
steps.instruction: Upstream owns preparation and its release updater, which replaces program files and restarts the launcher. Close the actual game and all helpers, retain independent recovery copies and complete maintenance outside an attached session, then review/relink changed executable bytes. Quit the game normally before closing its launcher: the GUI explicitly allows closing while the game continues. Its Stop path uses forced process-tree termination; that is not a save-flush or quiescence guarantee. Portcove does not adopt updater successors.

steps.title: Retain title and component boundaries
steps.instruction: This is the existing BilalReloaded/bc160201983 collection implementation, derived from gow3_pc/shadPS4, with documented port-specific maintenance; it is not merged with the separate Supermedo implementation by title alone. Preserve LICENSE.txt and all licenses/ component notices, including NVIDIA terms. Runtime grants do not grant original-game rights. Upstream per-title play/performance reports and incomplete test coverage remain upstream claims; no Portcove gameplay, save/reload, installed-app or Supported acceptance is asserted. Removing registration preserves all external files; managed install/update/rollback/backup/removal are unavailable.

warnings: Keep the complete independently permitted collection installation and every player-data root; upstream maintenance can restart the launcher and must finish outside attachment.
